parameters.name: filter[integration_instance_ids]
parameters.description: Preferred form (Amazon-unified plural). Comma-separated CSV; only the first ID is used. Resolves the Faire integration instance to scope the query to. If omitted/unknown, the endpoint returns an empty paginator instead of falling back to the first tenant.

parameters.name: filter[instance_id]
parameters.description: Legacy singular form. Same effect as `filter[integration_instance_ids]`. Either form is accepted.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with `-` for DESC. Default: `-ordered_at`. Allowed: id, ordered_at, shipped_at, delivered_at, created_at, updated_at, total, subtotal, discount_amount, status, retailer_name, retailer_country_code

parameters.name: filter[archived]
parameters.description: Archived toggle (mirrors the Purchase Orders bottom-bar pattern). Empty/missing = Active only (default). `only` = archived only. `all` = both.

parameters.name: filter[status]
parameters.description: Faire order status. Combine with `[is]`/`[is_not]`/`[is_one_of]` operators via `filter[status][is_one_of]=NEW,PROCESSING`.

parameters.name: filter[has_sku_order]
parameters.description: Boolean: `true` returns Faire orders linked to a SKU.io sales order. `false` returns orders awaiting auto-create.

parameters.name: filter[has_unmapped_items]
parameters.description: Boolean: `true` returns orders with at least one line item missing a SKU mapping.

parameters.name: filter[ordered_at]
parameters.description: Date range filter on `ordered_at`. Use `[between]`, `[gte]`, `[lte]` operators (see AdvancedFilterBuilder).
